accounting.note: The total counts ENTRIES in the central directory, not files. Directory entries are not files.

field_semantics.compressed_size_bytes: size of the deflated member data inside the archive
field_semantics.crc32: CRC-32 as published in the archive's central directory. A 32-bit cyclic redundancy check for error detection. NOT a cryptographic hash and never to be used as one. Collisions are trivially constructible; a CRC32 match does not establish that bytes are unaltered by an adversary.
field_semantics.dos_mod_date: raw MS-DOS date field, not decoded here
field_semantics.dos_mod_time: raw MS-DOS time field, not decoded here
field_semantics.local_header_offset: byte offset of the member's PK\x03\x04 local header within the archive; member data begins after the local header plus its own filename and extra-field lengths
field_semantics.uncompressed_size_bytes: size of the member after inflation

measurement.derived_from: the archive's own ZIP central directory
measurement.eocd_locator: zip64 end of central directory located via PK\x06\x07 in the final 70000 bytes
measurement.parser: struct.unpack('<HHHHHHIIIHHHHHII') over each PK\x01\x02 header; zip64 extra field 0x0001 consulted where a 32-bit field is 0xFFFFFFFF
measurement.serialisation: json.dumps(obj, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True) + trailing newline, LF line endings
measurement.transport: HTTP range requests (server returned 206; accept-ranges: bytes)
